title: Growing Pains
description: Little Lulu has been unhappy lately. She seems to be troubled by a certain something...

mainQuestExcel.title: Growing Pains
mainQuestExcel.description: Little Lulu has been unhappy lately. She seems to be troubled by a certain something...

dialogs.text: When will it be ready?
No playtime today?
Oh, hello! No, playtime doesn't seem to come at all these days.
Little Meng's in a bad mood and prefers to sulk by himself, and Little Fei keeps disappearing all the time.
I asked Little Meng what's wrong, but he wouldn't tell me. They're both acting so strange these days, I honestly don't know what's gotten into them.
Welcome to the grown-up world, kiddo.
Wait, so when you grow up you stop being happy? Then why do Little Meng and Little Fei want to grow up so bad...
I guess I'll just not grow up, then.
Anyway, we're getting sidetracked. I actually need your help with something.
Can you fetch something from Ying'er's place for me? We already talked about it, so she should have it ready by now.
My pleasure.
Yay! Thanks!
Ying'er's place, eh...
I don't know what you're thinking about, but it's not that. I just asked Ying'er to make something for me. And she said she would.
And now I'm asking you very nicely to help collect it for me.
Are you unhappy, too?
Me? No, I'm okay. But... I do need your help with something.
Well hello again. Missing me already, huh? What are you here for this time?
To pick something up for Little Lulu.
Little Lulu? ...Oh yes, that's right. She asked me to make some perfume for her.
But I'm afraid this isn't the best time... For some reason, since you were last here, my sweet-smelling side services have been in exceptionally high demand.
I've had an enormous number of orders. It's far too many for me to handle alone, especially since I also have the shop to attend to.
On top of that, Lulu's just a child. It would be a little inappropriate to give her the same type of perfume worn by adult women.
So I was racking my brains trying to think of a way to make my perfume more child-friendly. I've now decided on a suitable formula, but I haven't got around to making it yet.
If it absolutely can't wait, expediting it would not be impossible, but...

To pick something up for Little Lulu.
Little Lulu? ...Oh yes, that's right. She asked me to make some perfume for her.

On top of that, Lulu's just a child. It would be a little inappropriate to give her the same type of perfume worn by adult women.
So I was racking my brains trying to think of a way to make my perfume more child-friendly. I've now decided on a suitable formula, but I haven't got around to making it yet.
If it absolutely can't wait, expediting it would not be impossible, but...
Mint Essential Oil, you got it?
How do I make it?
We did it together not long ago, you don't remember? Huh, so you're just as quick to forget as you are to get involved in the first place...
Let me give you a recap then. Go fetch three leaves of Mint, then extract the essential oil at a Crafting Bench.
Bring the essential oil to me, and I will take it from there.
What uses does Mint Essential Oil have?
How to put this... it neutralizes some of the more stimulating elements in the concoction.
But more importantly, the scent is a good match for a child like Lulu.
A girl's scent is far more than a purely nasal affair...
This perfume must capture Lulu's youthful lust for life, her wide-eyed innocence... *giggle*
I don't know what's gotten into Little Meng and Little Fei recently...
The perfume is ready. A bespoke variety made with Mint Essential Oil.
Here you go. It's ready for Little Lulu now.
Okay.
Why Mint?
It counteracts some of the more... hmm, stimulating elements with its neutral scent...
To be honest, I was very surprised to receive an order from Lulu.
It does make me reminisce about being that age, when one has one's first taste of love, oh how it makes the heart flutter... If only I had been a little more worldly wise back then...
Ahem... Anyway, I should let you get back to Lulu.
Why the hurry? I'm afraid being desperate in and of itself can't bring you what you want.

I can help out.
